_comment: Variation of amnesia-hallucinating-grayswandir for read.c doread()'s confused-reading line, which also reads Hallucination. A lawful Samurai quaffs a cursed potion of hallucination (no enlightenment roll), wields Grayswandir (EHalluc_resistance), quaffs a potion of confusion and reads a scroll of identify, so C prints "Being confused, you mispronounce the magic words..." rather than "Being so trippy, you screw up...".

cursed potion of hallucination
qf Grayswandir
wg uncursed potion of confusion
qh uncursed scroll of identify
ri
